days.title: Arrival in London
days.desc: Welcome to London, a city with a rich history and vibrant culture. You'll be transferred to your hotel upon arrival. Spend the rest of the day exploring the city. If you're into shopping, Oxford Street and Harrods are must-visit spots.
days.taste: A classic London pub dinner — fish and chips, or a Sunday roast if the day fits.

days.title: London
days.desc: Explore London with a Hop on Hop off 1 day pass. The pass allows you to visit the city’s most famous landmarks at your own pace. You can visit the Tower of London, the British Museum, the London Eye, and many other attractions. The pass also includes a one-way Thames River cruise, which is a great way to see the city from a different perspective.
days.fallbackIncluded: Madam Tussauds ticket | Tower of London ticket | London Eye standard ticket
days.experience: Ride the top deck past Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament as the sun goes down.

days.title: London
days.desc: Today, you have the option to explore London at your own pace or take an optional tour to see Stonehenge and Bath.
days.shopping: Oxford Street and Covent Garden’s covered market for an afternoon of browsing.

days.title: London to Manchester
days.desc: Check out and journey by train to Manchester, a city steeped in industrial history and renowned for its vibrant cultural scene. Explore this dynamic cityscape alive with music, art, and world-famous football clubs.
days.taste: A Manchester tart — custard and raspberry jam — from one of the city’s bakeries.

days.title: Manchester
days.desc: Revel in a day of freedom in Manchester. Uncover the city's vibrant culture or opt for day trips to the picturesque Lake or Peak Districts, embracing the stunning natural landscapes.
days.fallbackIncluded: Windermere & the Lake District day trip | Derbyshire & the Peak District day trip
days.experience: An optional day trip into the Peak District’s limestone dales, a short hop from the city.

days.title: Manchester to Edinburgh
days.desc: Travel comfortably by train from Manchester to Edinburgh, immersing yourself in Scotland's capital known for its captivating history, striking architecture, and cultural festivals.

days.title: Manchester to Edinburgh
days.desc: Enjoy a day at your pace in Edinburgh. Discover the city's historic sites, wander along the Royal Mile, or visit the majestic Edinburgh Castle. Opt for a Hop-On Hop-Off tour or venture on a day trip to the enchanting Highlands to witness Scotland's breathtaking landscapes.
days.taste: A dram of single malt Scotch at a historic Royal Mile pub.

days.title: Edinburgh to Inverness
days.desc: Board the train from Edinburgh to Inverness, a journey that offers scenic views of Scotland's landscapes. Arrive in Inverness, the gateway to the Highlands, where history and natural beauty converge. Enjoy a tranquil evening in this charming Scottish city.
days.experience: The train climbs past the Cairngorms and skirts Loch Ness on the way north.

days.title: Inverness
days.desc: Embark on a captivating 12-hour coach tour to the picturesque Isle of Skye and the iconic Eilean Donan Castle. Traverse through Scotland's stunning landscapes, capturing the essence of its beauty and history. Return to Inverness for a serene evening.

days.title: Inverness to Glasgow
days.desc: Depart Inverness by train, traversing Scotland's landscapes towards the vibrant city of Glasgow. Embrace the cultural diversity and architectural wonders of this dynamic city upon arrival. Relax and prepare to explore Glasgow's charm.
days.shopping: Glasgow’s Buchanan Street and the Barras market for an afternoon of browsing.

days.title: Inverness to Glasgow
days.desc: Bid farewell to Glasgow as you're privately transferred from your hotel to Glasgow airport. Conclude your remarkable journey through Scotland, departing with cherished memories of its rich history and breathtaking landscapes.

days.title: Arrival in London
days.desc: Welcome to London, a city with a rich history and vibrant culture. You'll be transferred to your hotel upon arrival. Spend the rest of the day exploring the city. If you're into shopping, Oxford Street and Harrods are must-visit spots.
days.taste: A classic London pub dinner — fish and chips, or a Sunday roast if the day fits.

days.title: London
days.desc: Embark on a captivating 3-hour guided city tour, discovering London's iconic landmarks. Glide above the city with standard London Eye tickets and unwind on a serene Thames River cruise. Immerse yourself in the vibrant tapestry of London's culture.
days.fallbackIncluded: Madam Tussauds ticket | Tower of London ticket
days.experience: Glide past Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament on a private Thames cruise.

days.title: London
days.desc: Journey to the ancient mysteries of Stonehenge and the timeless allure of Bath. Explore these historic sites with included entrance tickets, tracing their fascinating narratives through time. Return to London for another night of exploration and enchantment.
days.taste: A Bath bun and a pot of tea in one of the city’s Georgian tea rooms.

days.title: London to Manchester
days.desc: Travel from London to Manchester with a delightful stop en route to explore the scenic beauty of the Peak District. Immerse yourself in nature's splendour before continuing your journey.
days.experience: A stop in the Peak District’s limestone dales en route to Manchester.

days.title: Manchester to Edinburgh
days.desc: Journey from Manchester to Edinburgh, pausing amidst the picturesque landscapes of the Lake District. Prepare for the allure of Edinburgh, a city steeped in history, known for its medieval Old Town and elegant Georgian New Town.

days.title: Edinburgh
days.desc: Discover Edinburgh at your pace with a self-guided city tour. Traverse its historic streets, marvel at architectural wonders, and immerse yourself in the city's captivating ambiance. Explore the majestic Edinburgh Castle, vibrant Princes Street, and more.
days.taste: A dram of single malt Scotch at a historic Royal Mile pub.

days.title: Edinburgh to Inverness
days.desc: Travel from Edinburgh to Inverness, passing through the legendary Loch Ness and the breathtaking Highlands. Nestled by the River Ness, Inverness, the Highland capital, boasts historic sites like Inverness Castle and the serene Caledonian Canal.
days.experience: The drive north passes Loch Ness on the way into the Highlands.

days.title: Inverness
days.desc: Immerse yourself in a captivating journey to the Isle of Skye from Inverness. Discover the island's natural beauty, rugged landscapes, and ancient castles. Traverse iconic sites like the Old Man of Storr and the picturesque Fairy Pools. Return for a serene evening in Inverness.

days.title: Inverness to Glasgow
days.desc: Travel from Inverness to Glasgow, passing by the scenic Loch Lomond and the historic town of Fort William. Glasgow, Scotland's largest city, is known for its vibrant arts scene, architectural marvels, and rich industrial heritage.
days.shopping: Glasgow’s Buchanan Street for an afternoon of browsing before dinner.

days.title: Departure
days.desc: Bid farewell to Glasgow as you're privately transferred from your hotel to Glasgow airport. Conclude your remarkable journey with cherished memories of the diverse landscapes and vibrant cities experienced throughout your tour.

about.title: Best season
about.body: May–September for long days; shoulder months quieter and better value

about.title: Weather
about.body: Mild and changeable. 12–20°C in summer. Pack a rain layer year-round

goodToKnow.title: Best season
goodToKnow.body: April–September for long days and best weather; shoulder months quieter and often better value.

goodToKnow.title: Currency & documents
goodToKnow.body: England/Scotland use £ GBP. Ireland uses € EUR. Both are Schengen-free — check your entry requirements.

goodToKnow.title: What to pack
goodToKnow.body: Layers and a waterproof in any month. Comfortable shoes for cobbles and coastal paths.

goodToKnow.title: Rail travel
goodToKnow.body: Seat reservations are included on inter-city trains. Arrive 10 minutes before departure.

goodToKnow.title: Your vehicle
goodToKnow.body: Driver hours are limited to 10 hrs/day by law. Luggage space fits one large case per guest.

terms: All rates are net and per person for the package.

Child rates apply for children aged from 2 to 11 years old. 1 child sharing a room with 2 adults (depending on hotel policy). If the hotel doesn’t have availability for family rooms, adult rates will apply.
All rates are subject to availability at the time of booking. Europe Incoming will endeavour to match the rates quoted in the packages.
Rates quoted are not applicable during trade fair periods, major European Holidays and other major events.
City taxes are not included in the price.
If certain entrances are closed during certain periods, alternative entrances will be provided.
All bookings have to be confirmed at least 60 working days prior to arrival date by the Agent. Early bookings increase the chances of achieving the quoted package rate.
The prices we quote are indicative, but we always try to confirm the prices offered in this document.
We require 100% pre-payment either by bank transfer or by credit card (VISA or Mastercard). All charges for bank transfers need to be covered by the Agent.
Vouchers will be issued after receipt of the full payment in our bank account.
